name: Misora Links
description: Misora Links is an understated, serif-led WordPress theme designed for traditional members' golf clubs and hospitality retreats. Rooted in coastal atmosphere, it features ticket-notch frames, a horizontal morning sheet rail, and balanced editorial typography. Built with modern block patterns, the theme delivers calm, dependable performance across all devices.
